gloss: to encourage; to give someone a push

definitions.gloss: to encourage (someone to act); to give someone a push
definitions.explanation: To give someone the encouragement or final push they need to make a decision or take a step they were hesitating over. Also used literally of pushing someone's back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{背中|せなか}を{押|お}して⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: My friend gave me the push I needed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一言|ひとこと}→一言：03708_hitokoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{背中|せなか}を{押|お}された。
examples.english: A single word from my teacher gave me the courage to go ahead.

examples.japanese: ⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{迷|まよ}っていた→迷う：02426_mayou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{両親|りょうしん}→両親：00806_ryoushin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{背中|せなか}を{押|お}して⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{決心|けっしん}→決心：02700_kesshin⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I was unsure whether to study abroad, but my parents encouraged me, so I was able to make up my mind.

notes:
Conjugates like ⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧ (godan). Very often appears as {背中|せなか}を{押|お}して⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧ (someone kindly encourages me) or in the passive, {背中|せなか}を{押|お}される (to be spurred on).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {背中|せなか}を{押|お}して⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧: to encourage me
- {背中|せなか}を{押|お}される: to be encouraged, spurred on
- ⟦{一言|ひとこと}→一言：03708_hitokoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{背中|せなか}を{押|お}される: to be spurred on by a single remark

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{励|はげ}ます→励ます：05304_hagemasu⟧: to encourage in general, to cheer up; {背中|せなか}を{押|お}す is specifically the push that gets someone to act on a decision

cross_references.label: to encourage in general, to cheer up
